en:
It all began two days prior, when
Monokuma gave us the <CLT=cltSTRONG>additional motive<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

The time limit added to this
killing game triggered the crime.

After the announcement, some of us decided
to form groups to plan our next move.

I had my own plan to find the <CLT=cltSTRONG>mastermind<CLT=cltNORMAL>,
and <CLT=cltSTRONG>someone<CLT=cltNORMAL> offered to help me...

At the time, I never would have
imagined they would become the <CLT=cltSTRONG>culprit<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

To expose the mastermind, the culprit
and I set up <CLT=cltSTRONG>hidden cameras<CLT=cltNORMAL> in the <CLT=cltSTRONG>library<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

There was a <CLT=cltSTRONG>hidden door<CLT=cltNORMAL> in the
library that showed signs of use.

We deduced that the mastermind would
return there, to let Monokuma out.

The next day, we asked <CLT=cltSTRONG>Miu<CLT=cltNORMAL> if
she could modify some cameras for our trap.

We then went to the <CLT=cltSTRONG>warehouse<CLT=cltNORMAL>
to gather the necessary materials.

All we needed were <CLT=cltSTRONG>disposable cameras<CLT=cltNORMAL>
and a <CLT=cltSTRONG>security sensor<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

But the culprit found something else
there—the <CLT=cltSTRONG>murder weapon<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
That's right. The <CLT=cltSTRONG>shot put ball<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

They put the cameras as well as the shot
in their backpack.

Then, on the day the time limit would
expire, the day of the murder...

the culprit and I collected the modified
cameras from Miu and visited the library.

Once there, we searched the room for
ideal locations to place the cameras.

But even then, the culprit was
preparing the <CLT=cltSTRONG>murder<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

They began by removing the <CLT=cltSTRONG>vent grate<CLT=cltNORMAL>,
and laid it inside the air duct.

Then, they moved the <CLT=cltSTRONG>pile of books<CLT=cltNORMAL> on top
of the bookcase, pretending to organize them.

After that, they placed open <CLT=cltSTRONG>encyclopedias<CLT=cltNORMAL>
on the final bookcase.

It appeared innocuous enough, but it
was actually a <CLT=cltSTRONG>path for the murder weapon<CLT=cltNORMAL>!

The culprit also tampered with the
<CLT=cltSTRONG>hidden camera linked to the security sensor<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

I was responsible for setting up
the other cameras, but that one...
I didn't even notice their trick.

They used <CLT=cltSTRONG>duct tape<CLT=cltNORMAL> to
keep the <CLT=cltSTRONG>flash function<CLT=cltNORMAL> on.

After the cameras were set, the culprit and I
climbed the stairs to the 1st floor classroom.

We kept a lookout for the others and
waited for the <CLT=cltSTRONG>security sensor<CLT=cltNORMAL> to go off.

During the stakeout, we saw Kaito
and six others go down to the basement.

Rantaro was with them...
The <CLT=cltSTRONG>first victim<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

After watching that group enter the
Game Room, I returned to the classroom.

With about one hour remaining, the
<CLT=cltSTRONG>security receiver<CLT=cltNORMAL> I was holding went off.

I assumed it was the mastermind, so I
ran out of the classroom to the library.

I was in such a hurry, I
left the culprit behind.

Looking back on it now...that was the
last chance I had to stop the murder.

After I had left, the culprit took
the shot put ball out of their backpack...

and rolled it into the
<CLT=cltSTRONG>classroom vent<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
This set the murder in motion!

<CLT=cltSTRONG>Rantaro<CLT=cltNORMAL> had moved the
<CLT=cltSTRONG>bookcase<CLT=cltNORMAL>, triggering the receiver.
Unbeknownst to him, the trap had been sprung.

First, the modified camera took a
picture of Rantaro with the flash on.

Rantaro noticed the flash and approached
the bookcase to inspect the camera.

The <CLT=cltSTRONG>camera flash<CLT=cltNORMAL> lured Rantaro
directly into the <CLT=cltSTRONG>murder weapon's path<CLT=cltNORMAL>!

The shot the culprit tossed into
the vent rolled through the air duct...

came out of the library's vent, and
kept rolling atop the bookcase.

Opening the vent grate and organizing
the books was all to create a path.

Under normal circumstances, the victim
would have been alerted by the noise...

but the <CLT=cltSTRONG>promotional video<CLT=cltNORMAL> was
masking the sound of the shot rolling.

The shot kept rolling, then fell on
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Rantaro's head<CLT=cltNORMAL>, killing him instantly.

By the time we had entered the room,
the murder was complete.

I imagine...seeing Rantaro's body,
the culprit probably thought...

"The mastermind is dead, the game is over,
now we can all go home..."

But their wish didn't come true...
Because Rantaro wasn't the mastermind!

It was murder...in an attempt to save all our
lives. That is the <CLT=cltSTRONG>truth<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

That's the truth behind your lies...
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Kaede Akamatsu, the Ultimate Pianist<CLT=cltNORMAL>!
Kaito, Gonta, and Tenko
Bow to Miu Iruma
